mapper.sql: tag_id, scope, category, sentiment, label, sort_order, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback_tags (scope, category, sentiment, label, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{category}, #{sentiment}, #{label}, #{sortOrder}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM feedback_tags WHERE scope = #{scope} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY category, sort_order, tag_id
